title: “If the resistance is rising… good.
paragraphs:
“If the resistance is rising… good.
It means Heaven has aligned you with your calling.
What God assigned to you will not collapse under pressure —
it will grow stronger through it.”
✨ Step into what God called you to do. The resistance is not a sign to stop — it’s a sign you’re finally walking in the right direction.
Romans 8:31 — “If God is for us, who can be against us?”
